items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: Charlie Chris, he had told me about a Dr. Brennan on New and all, it was a very good cancerous freshness and for me to come down in there and take a look at my lip.

ctx.x: Oh yes, and he went around the whole world. Yeah, yeah, yeah.

Egypt, everything. Yeah, that's it. So that's where he comes up. What it was, something happened between him and Bonnie and you don't know what happened. So that was causing that. Then that's all that's going on now and the band is still together up until 1926. In 1926 in February, I had to leave the band because I had developed a canceroid cancer on my lip. On my lip. Now, Charlie Chris, I was still, Charlie Chris, he had told me about a Dr. Brennan on New and all, it was a very good cancerous freshness and for…
He had been to Charlie Elgin. I didn't know that. That's right.
